items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: But then I befriended a good colleague of his, Larry Abel, who became my copyist for years.

ctx.x: Man, I bet your made sure that the parts were all correct. I mean did you do the copying by yourself at that time?

You would think I would do that. You would think I would make all kinds of painful reviewing. But luckily a lot of the guys in the band were my friends and they corrected a lot of mistakes for me. The parts were in pencil. The parts were in pencil. However, when we finally got to the RCA Victor recording, this was in the old days when the record companies paid for the copyist, they paid the composer and the arranger, everything was union scale.
